answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond sealed in violet. Each epoch a saffron beacon draws a random 20% sample for a freshness check: a picked agent must show a 10-credit proof of work or its bond decays 25%. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000; checks cost 2,000 per epoch, 40,000 in 20 epochs, or 60,000 burns in four epochs as the fakes wander off, against a 40,000 pool. A rented answer burns the bond. An honest agent locks 60 once and keeps its share.
